source.:question/problem:
Let $S=UV.$ What is the value of ${s}_{13}$, if

$$
U=\begin{bmatrix}-2 & 3 & -1 \\ 3 & 0 & 4\end{bmatrix},\,V=\begin{bmatrix}-1 & -2 & 3 \\ 1 & 3 & -2 \\ 10 & 2 & -5\end{bmatrix}?
$$
source.:question/worked-solution:
Multiplying the $1$st row in $U$ by the $3$rd column in $V$, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{s}_{13} & =\begin{bmatrix}-2 & 3 & -1 \\ 3 & 0 & 4\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}-1 & -2 & 3 \\ 1 & 3 & -2 \\ 10 & 2 & -5\end{bmatrix} \\  & =\begin{bmatrix}-2 & 3 & -1\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}3 \\ -2 \\ -5\end{bmatrix} \\  & =(-2)\cdot 3+3\cdot (-2)+(-1)\cdot (-5) \\  & =-6-6+5 \\  & =-7.\end{aligned}
$$

$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
Multiplying the $1$st row in $U$ by the $1$st column in $V$, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{s}_{11} & =\begin{bmatrix}-2 & 3 & -1 \\ 3 & 0 & 4\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}-1 & -2 & 3 \\ 1 & 3 & -2 \\ 10 & 2 & -5\end{bmatrix} \\  & =\begin{bmatrix}-2 & 3 & -1\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}-1 \\ 1 \\ 10\end{bmatrix} \\  & =(-2)\cdot (-1)+3\cdot 1+(-1)\cdot 10 \\  & =2+3-10 \\  & =-5.\end{aligned}

source.:question/problem:
Let $D=AB.$ What is the value of ${d}_{24}$, if

$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}-1 & 2 & 4 \\ 3 & 4 & -1 \\ -1 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 4 & -7\end{bmatrix},\,B=\begin{bmatrix}1 & 1 & -2 & -3 \\ 0 & 4 & -1 & 1 \\ 2 & 0 & 3 & -3\end{bmatrix}?
$$
source.:question/worked-solution:
Multiplying the $2$nd row in $A$ by the $4$th column in $B$, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{d}_{24} & =\begin{bmatrix}-1 & 2 & 4 \\ 3 & 4 & -1 \\ -1 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 4 & -7\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}1 & 1 & -2 & -3 \\ 0 & 4 & -1 & 1 \\ 2 & 0 & 3 & -3\end{bmatrix} \\  & =\begin{bmatrix}3 & 4 & -1\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}-3 \\ 1 \\ -3\end{bmatrix} \\  & =3\cdot (-3)+4\cdot 1+(-1)\cdot (-3) \\  & =-9+4+3 \\  & =-2.\end{aligned}
$$

$$
question.:question/worked-solution:

source.:question/problem:
Let $T=UV.$ What is the value of ${t}_{41}$, if

$$
U=\begin{bmatrix}-1 & 4 & -1 \\ -2 & 2 & 10 \\ -3 & 1 & -1 \\ -5 & 3 & 10\end{bmatrix},\,V=\begin{bmatrix}-2 & -3 & -2 \\ -1 & 10 & -1 \\ -1 & 20 & -1\end{bmatrix}?
$$
source.:question/worked-solution:
Multiplying the $4$th row of $U$ by the $1$st column in $V$, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{t}_{41} & =\begin{bmatrix}-1 & 4 & -1 \\ -2 & 2 & 10 \\ -3 & 1 & -1 \\ -5 & 3 & 10\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}-2 & -3 & -2 \\ -1 & 10 & -1 \\ -1 & 20 & -1\end{bmatrix} \\  & =\begin{bmatrix}-5 & 3 & 10\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}-2 \\ -1 \\ -1\end{bmatrix} \\  & =(-5)\cdot (-2)+3\cdot (-1)+10\cdot (-1) \\  & =10-3-10 \\  & =-3.\end{aligned}
$$

question.:question/worked-solution:

Let $R=PQ.$ What is the value of ${r}_{25}$, if

$$
P=\begin{bmatrix}1 & -2 \\ 3 & -4 \\ 4 & -6 \\ 1 & -8 \\ 3 & -9\end{bmatrix},\,Q=\begin{bmatrix}0 & 1 & 2 & -1 & 10 \\ 2 & 0 & 5 & -2 & 7\end{bmatrix}?
